title: Give the macOS release-candidate qualification 120 minutes
description: Give the macOS release-candidate qualification 120 minutes
no_spec_change_rationale: A CI job limit and a release handoff note. No module contract, requirement or product behaviour changes.
acceptance_criteria: The `qualify` job in `.github/workflows/release.yml` has `timeout-minutes: 120`, and its comment says why. The 6.4.2 handoff records that `v6.4.2-rc.1` was cancelled on macOS at 75 minutes with every test passed and that the candidate is cut again. The version validator, the workflow-pin validator and the release-candidate contract tests pass. No product, test or spec file changes.
